question: What condition must hold for the act of applying meditation to follow worship of the circle in this prescribed sequence?
premises: Worship of the circle is performed as a prior act.
Meditation is applied for as long as a stated temporal condition holds.
The application of meditation is presented as the consequent action in sequence.
inference: The prescribed practice links prior worship of the circle to sustained application of meditation under a temporal limit.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the temporal limit yāvat remains context-dependent.
plain_english: Having worshipped this circle, one applies meditation for as long as the prescribed condition holds.
